label: copy phase: just re-emitted "3", now outputting "m" (original bigram "3 m"), late in the copy
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and 97% of its activation mass falls on steps whose input is the digit 3, i.e. the model has just re-emitted a 3. It is strongest when the next token to output is m, so the original sequence held the bigram "3 m". 76% of mass has out_tok=m, and every top activation is the step "3 -> m". It also needs to be late in the copy (recall_idx >= 3, mostly t >= 12): the same 3->m transition at recall_idx 0-2 or in short sequences is usually silent. Rate rises with recall_idx and L. Weaker, low-magnitude activations happen on input 3 with other outputs (h, 3, d, t, ...), plus a few on input m. It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, and never when the input is any token other than 3 or m. On dev the predicate scores precision 0.86, recall 0.53, mass recall 0.73; the misses are mostly low-activation steps where 3 is followed by something other than m.
